analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI remains at 61.3 in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram worsened from 0.0890 to -0.4793, continuing bearish signals. The 5-day high/low pattern formed a Higher Low compared to the 20-day high/low, indicating a recovery signal. Trading volume surged 2.36 times the 5-day average, adding conviction to the move. However, MACD deterioration and RSI staying neutral are the primary factors for the wait-and-see decision.
